title: Reference template
description: Expected ranges for one form type. Every metric must be traceable to a source in docs/SOURCES.md and must declare its angle convention. template_validator.py enforces this at boot - a template that fails validation stops the service rather than silently scoring against unsourced numbers.

form_type.description: Matches the filename stem and the formType sent by the client.

version.description: Semver. Stored on every analysisResult so historical scores remain interpretable after a template changes.

phase_events.description: Event names this form type emits. Must match phase_detection output exactly.

metrics.description: Keyed by metric key from metric_tiers.REGISTRY.

style_variants.description: Optional per-style overrides. Resolution order: declared-style variant with its own source, else the style-agnostic metrics block, else unscored. Never synthesise a style-specific range.

tier.description: Must equal the tier in metric_tiers.REGISTRY. Duplicated here so a template drifting from the registry is caught rather than silently overriding it.

event.description: Measurement event, or 'A->B' for a span. Must appear in phase_events.

convention.description: Angle convention. MANDATORY and nullable: null for non-angle metrics, otherwise straight_180 or flexion_from_0. These two are inverses; mixing them silently flips a grade. Null must be an explicit choice, not an omission.

band_derivation.description: How the band was obtained. 'derived_conversion' requires a derivation note. 'observed_cohort' means measured from footage by cohort/build.py rather than taken from literature, and requires a 'cohort' block. 'todo' requires expected_low and expected_high to be null, and makes the metric unscored.

cohort.description: Required when band_derivation is 'observed_cohort'. Records how the band was measured so a future reader can judge it without re-running anything.

observed_sd.description: Raw spread across the cohort: real variation between players AND measurement error together.

measurement_sem.description: Mean measurement error of the contributing clips. If this approaches observed_sd, the band is mostly noise.

true_sd_estimate.description: sqrt(observed_sd^2 - measurement_sem^2): the spread attributable to players actually differing. This is what the band width uses.

source.description: Citation key from docs/SOURCES.md. Empty string only permitted when band_derivation is 'todo'.

population.description: Who the range came from. Elite male ranges must not be applied to a junior without the UI saying so.

confidence.description: Quality of the underlying evidence: sample size, reliability, task similarity. Scales nothing automatically - it is surfaced to the user alongside the range.

discriminates_skill.description: Must match metric_tiers.REGISTRY. False for variables shown not to separate skill levels (bat angle, bat speed, shoulder angle); these carry zero score weight.

derivation.description: Required when band_derivation is 'derived_conversion'. State every assumption, e.g. a population mean stature used to normalise a value reported in metres.
